# Whisper Messenger

  [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger)](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/releases/latest)
  [![Release Date](https://img.shields.io/github/release-date/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger)](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/releases/latest)
  [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/ci.yml?label=CI)](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

[![BuyMeACoffee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pachadotdev/buymeacoffee-badges/main/bmc-donate-yellow.svg)](https://buymeacoffee.com/f0rty_tw0)

  **Never lose a whisper again.**

  Every conversation lands in one messenger window with history, online status and unread badges, like the messenger you already use, inside World of Warcraft.

  🏆 5th place in [The Addon Trials](https://mod.curseforge.com/modding-contests/wow_midnight-addon_contest/), CurseForge's 2026 WoW addon contest.

![Whisper Messenger in the Native WoW HUD Modern style, showing a whisper over 700 characters long as one message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/hud-modern-long-whisper.png)

## Why players install it

- **Whispers stop drowning in raid, trade and guild spam.** Each person gets their own conversation with an unread badge, so you always know who is waiting on you.
- **Say it in one message.** Whispers can run to about 800 characters instead of the game's 255.
- **Trade and General without the spam.** Follow world channels in their own tab, with ready-made filters for gold sellers, boosting ads and link spam.
- **Looks like it shipped with the game.** The Native WoW HUD style uses Blizzard's own window frame and tabs.
- **Yesterday's conversation is still there.** History survives logout and is shared across your characters.
- **See who is online and where before you whisper.** Class, faction, zone and Battle.net status sit right in the contact list.
- **Battle.net and character whispers, side by side.** No more guessing which tab a friend wrote in.

## "Can't I just make a Whispers chat tab?"

You can, and it helps. A tab still mixes everyone into one scrolling stream, forgets everything on logout, has no unread count per person and no online status. Whisper Messenger gives every person their own thread with all of that.

## Features

### Messenger-Style Conversations

Chat bubbles with timestamps, date separators and sender labels. Right-click any message to reply, copy it or add a reaction. An emoji picker sits next to the message box.

- **Long whispers** run to about 800 characters. They go out in up to four parts and show as one message when your friend also uses Whisper Messenger. Group chats keep the game's normal length.
- **Reply** quotes the original line above your message.
- **Quick replies** drop in a saved line like "On my way" (up to 10, edit them under Options > Behavior).
- **Drafts** stay with each chat, even after a reload.
- **Queued messages** wait safely when whispers are paused, and nothing is sent until you click.
- **Filtered messages** that the game flags as inappropriate stay hidden until you click to reveal them.

  ![Whisper Messenger window with replies, reactions and a Seen receipt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/chat-reactions-seen.png)

  ![A reply quoting an earlier message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/chat-reply-quote.png)
  ![Right-click menu with reactions, Reply and Copy text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/message-menu-reactions.png)

  ![Quick replies menu next to the message box](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/quick-replies.png)

  ![A filtered message hidden behind Show Message, with click to reveal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/censored-message.png)

### Contact List

Online status dots, unread badges, last-message previews, and the zone or dungeon a friend is in. Pin and drag contacts to reorder them. Search across names, nicknames, notes and message history.

Right-click a contact to **mute** them, set a **nickname**, add a private **note**, or get told when they come **online** or **change zone**.

  ![Contact right-click menu with Mute, Set nickname, Edit note and Notify when online](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/contact-menu.png)

### Whispers, Groups, Channels and Requests

- **Whispers** holds your private conversations.
- **Groups** collects party, raid, instance and guild chat, with reactions and @mention highlights.
- **Channels** (optional) turns Trade, General, Local Defense, LFG and your custom channels into chats of their own. Pick them under Options > Chats.
- **Requests** (optional) holds whispers from strangers until you accept or delete them. Turn it on under Options > Behavior.

  ![Raid chat in the Groups tab with a New messages line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/group-raid-chat.png)
  ![Requests tab with Accept and Delete buttons for a stranger's whisper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/requests-tab.png)

### Global Channels

Trade, General, Local Defense, World Defense, LFG and Trade (Services) each get their own chat and icon in the Channels tab. A busy channel only counts as unread when someone says your name, so Trade never buries a friend's whisper.

  ![Trade channel open in the Channels tab, next to General and Trade (Services)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/channels-trade.png)

### Spam Protection

- **Block players** for a day, a week or forever, with an optional note. Their whispers, group and channel messages disappear, in the messenger and in the game's chat.
- **Keyword rules** hide matching lines. Ready-made rules cover "Anal" link spam, Thunderfury links, Mythic+ and raid sellers, profession sellers, power-leveling sellers, guild and community recruitment, and WTS / WTB / LFW.
- Ready-made rules only touch channels such as Trade, never your guild, party or raid, and never whispers.
- Nothing is hidden from the game's chat in Mythic+, boss fights or PvP.

  ![Filters settings: how filters work, blocked players and ready-made keyword rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/settings-filters.png)

### Battle.net Integration

Character whispers and Battle.net friend whispers live in one list. Contact details stay in sync with your friends list in real time.

### Friends Who Also Use It

When a friend also runs Whisper Messenger you get typing indicators, "Seen" receipts and reactions attached to the original message. Both can be switched off in Behavior settings. Players without the addon still receive a readable plain-text fallback.

The chat header shows **(Uses WM)** for friends who have it, and an **(Invite to WM)** link for those who don't.

  ![Contact list showing typing… under a friend's name](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/typing-indicator.png)
  ![A Seen receipt above a sent message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/seen-receipt.png)

### Themes

A modern, clean look with five color themes: **Midnight**, **Shadowlands**, **Draenor**, **Pandaria** and **Azeroth**. Themes apply instantly, no reload.

Prefer the game's own style? Set **Native WoW HUD** under Options > Appearance to **Modern** for the current Blizzard window with its round portrait and bottom tabs, or **Classic** for the older frame.

  ![Guild chat in the Native WoW HUD Modern style with the narrow contact list and Whispers, Groups and Channels tabs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/hud-modern-guild-chat.png)

### Fonts and Scale

Pick the default font or any font from SharedMedia addons like ElvUI. Resize the whole window from 75% to 150%.

### Notifications

Choose a notification sound from one dropdown: 16 built-in game sounds (Whisper, Ping, Chime, Bell, Raid Warning and more), plus any sound shared by SharedMedia addons like ElvUI. It plays even when in-game sound effects are muted.

The floating button shows an unread badge and a short preview of the newest message.

  ![Floating button with an unread badge and a message preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/widget-preview.png)

### Auto-Open Window

Opens the messenger when you receive a whisper, pick "Whisper" on a player, or click a name. Configurable in Behavior settings, and never during combat.

### Linking

Shift-click items, quests, achievements, spells and professions to link them straight into your message.

### Settings

Pages for **General**, **Appearance**, **Behavior**, **Whispers**, **Chats**, **Filters**, **Notifications**, **Widget** and **What's New**. Includes history limits and retention, privacy options, 12 interface languages, a profanity filter toggle, a hide-from-default-chat option and auto-focus control.

  ![General settings: history limits, privacy, time format and interface language](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/settings-general.png)
  ![Appearance settings: themes, scale, fonts and bubble colors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/settings-appearance.png)

  ![Behavior settings: auto-open, combat, requests, typing status and read receipts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/settings-behavior.png)
  ![Widget settings: size, badge, widget preview and icon mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/master/.github/assets/settings-icons.png)

## Good to know

Blizzard blocks all addon whisper communication during Mythic+ dungeons, rated Battlegrounds and raid boss encounters. This is a game-level restriction, not a limitation of Whisper Messenger. The addon detects these situations, steps aside so whispers fall through to the default chat, and resumes when you're done.

## Compatibility

Whisper Messenger works on **all WoW flavors**:

| Flavor                    | Status    |
| ------------------------- | --------- |
| Retail (Mainline)         | Supported |
| Classic Era               | Supported |
| Season of Discovery       | Supported |
| TBC Classic Anniversary   | Supported |
| Cataclysm Classic         | Supported |
| Mists of Pandaria Classic | Supported |
| WoW: Forever              | Beta      |

A single install covers every client. WoW loads the correct version automatically.

## Download

### CurseForge (Recommended)

Install via the [CurseForge App](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/whisper-messenger) for automatic updates.

### Wago

Also available on [Wago Addons](https://addons.wago.io/addons/whispermessenger).

### GitHub Releases

Download the latest ZIP from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/releases/latest) and extract it into your `Interface/AddOns/` folder.

## Configuration

Open or close the messenger with **CTRL-O** (change it in the game's Key Bindings menu).

Open settings with the gear icon in the messenger window, or type:

```
/wmsg
```

## Contributing

Pull requests are welcome! The project uses Lua 5.1 with StyLua for formatting and Luacheck for static analysis.

### Lint

```bash
bash scripts/lint.sh          # check
bash scripts/lint.sh --fix    # auto-format + check
```

#### Windows local setup

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-lint-tools.ps1
bash scripts/lint.sh
```

### Tests

```bash
# Run a single test file
lua tests/run.lua tests/path/to/test_file.lua

# No Lua on Windows? Use the Python + lupa harness
python scripts/run_test.py tests/path/to/test_file.lua

# Run all tests
find tests -type f -name 'test_*.lua' | sort | while read -r f; do lua tests/run.lua "$f"; done
```

Both lint and tests must pass before merging.

# Changelog

Player-friendly release notes for WhisperMessenger. This file covers the current 2.x series; older series live in [archive/changelog/](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog).

All releases: **2.2.x (current)** · [2.1.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/2.1.md) · [2.0.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/2.0.md) · [1.4.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.4.md) · [1.3.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.3.md) · [1.2.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.2.md) · [1.1.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.1.md) · [1.0.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.0.md) · [0.1.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/0.1.md)

## [Unreleased]

## [2.2.0] - 2026-11-27

- On WoW: Forever, you can now use the messenger with a controller: move through your chats and buttons, scroll the chat, and press B to close.
- On WoW: Forever, the settings pages now work with a controller, including picking a choice from a drop-down list with the D-pad, however long the list is.
- On WoW: Forever, pop-up pickers and dialogs now work with a controller.
- On WoW: Forever with a controller, press A on the message box to start typing and A again to send; B leaves the message box. A small hint shows both buttons. Typing itself still needs an on-screen keyboard or a real one.
- On WoW: Forever with a controller, sliders now have − and + buttons (the D-pad stops on those, so pressing A can no longer make a slider jump) and the blocked players list has up and down buttons; they show only while the game's controller mode is on. The D-pad moves across the title bar, the settings list and the Whispers / Groups tabs in the order you see them, and on a settings page up and down go through its controls row by row, left and right stay in the row, and left from the first control goes back to the page's name in the list.
- On WoW: Forever with a controller, press X on a contact, a message or the chat header to open its menu.
- Fixed: on WoW: Forever with the game's controller mode on, right-clicking a contact, a message or a player name in a chat no longer causes "Interface action failed" in combat or blocks the Group Finder afterwards. Whisper Messenger shows its own menu there while controller mode is on; with the mouse, the game's usual menus are back.
- Fixed: on WoW: Forever with the game's controller mode on, settings drop-down lists open WhisperMessenger's own list (in the game's style under the Native look), so they no longer interfere with other game menus or the controller's back button. Under the Native look, the game's usual drop-down lists come back when you play with the mouse.
- Fixed: on WoW: Forever with the game's controller mode on, the New Whisper button no longer stops the controller from working or causes "Interface action failed" until a reload. It asks for the name in Whisper Messenger's own pop-up there.
- Fixed: the What's New title no longer runs under the scrollbar when the window is narrow; it drops the date, and if it still doesn't fit it ends in "...".
- Fixed: on WoW: Forever under the Native look, the settings drop-down lists are no longer see-through, and the chosen option is marked with a check in gold text.
- Fixed: on WoW: Forever, some settings drop-down lists no longer open as an empty box.
- Fixed: a drop-down list near the bottom of a settings page is no longer cut off: the page scrolls to show it, and where it can't, the list opens upward.
- Fixed: scrolling through the Filters or Behavior settings page could make the game slow down more and more until the page was closed.
- Receiving whispers costs less performance when you have many saved conversations.
- The chat window feels smoother while you type long messages or resize it.
- Fixed: with group chats turned off, guild, party and raid chat is no longer saved in the background and no longer pushes out older whisper conversations. Mention alerts from those chats also stay quiet while group chats are off.
- Fixed: starting a Battle.net whisper in the game's chat no longer adds an empty conversation to the messenger or pushes out an older one.

# Changelog

Player-friendly release notes for WhisperMessenger. This file covers the current 2.x series; older series live in [archive/changelog/](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog).

All releases: **2.1.x (current)** · [2.0.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/2.0.md) · [1.4.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.4.md) · [1.3.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.3.md) · [1.2.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.2.md) · [1.1.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.1.md) · [1.0.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/1.0.md) · [0.1.x](https://github.com/F0rty-Tw0/WhisperMessenger/blob/master/archive/changelog/0.1.md)

## [Unreleased]

## [2.1.9] - 2026-11-21

- New option at the top of Notifications: "Mute all sounds" silences every Whisper Messenger sound at once. Your sound choices are kept for when you turn it off, and picking a sound still plays a preview.
- New whispers take up much less memory (about half for whispers with characters) and less room in your saved chat history file. Your chats look the same.
- Whispers with a character that belongs to one of your Battle.net friends now go into that friend's Battle.net chat, and an earlier chat with that character joins it, so each friend has one chat.
- In a Battle.net friend's chat, messages they sent from one of their characters show the friend's name with the character's name next to it, like "Jaina - via Arthas".
- Right-click a Battle.net friend's chat and pick "Separate " to move that character's messages back into a chat of their own. Whispers with that character then stay in their own chat for good.
- The "Icons" settings page is now called "Widget".
- The square widget now matches the round one: same size, same idle grey, and with the background on the same hover. With the background off, hovering lights up the square's edge. With EllesmereUI installed, the square still follows your EllesmereUI action-bar look.
- New setting under Appearance to hide the emoji button. The message box gets the freed space.
- Press Up in an empty message box to bring back what you sent earlier, from any chat. Up and Down step through your sent messages.
- Fixed: clicking links in the messenger could later break Blizzard windows (errors when opening your character panel, toys that wouldn't use).
- Fixed: the message box no longer shows a thin slice of the previous line along its top edge once a long message scrolls.
- Fixed: when the message box grows to two lines right after a reload, the window now makes room for it instead of letting the box cover the line above it.
- Fixed: party, raid and instance chats now clear out after your Message Retention time like whispers do. Before, leaving the group or logging back in counted as new activity, so an old group chat could stay in your list for days.
- Fixed: notices in a chat, like "player is offline" or "Left party", no longer move that chat to the top of your list or keep it from clearing out after your Message Retention time, also after you remove an unsent message or when two chats with the same person are joined. Only real messages count.
- Fixed: when two chats with the same person are joined into one, the chat list now shows the last line of the joined chat instead of an older message.

## [2.1.8] - 2026-11-16

- "Clear on logout" now also deletes the channel messages Whisper Messenger keeps to show above a new whisper. Before, they stayed saved until your next login.
- Smoother with a long Battle.net friend list: while the window is open, Whisper Messenger now does far less work each time a whisper arrives or a friend's status changes, and redraws the window far less often when the change is for a friend you have no chat with.
- The message box now grows up to two lines as you type a long message, instead of scrolling sideways.
- With the Native WoW look, the message box now uses the game's own text box border, which keeps the same thickness when the box grows.
- The message box, search box and other text boxes keep your theme's font again, and switch to the game's chat font only while you type a letter like ő or ű.
- Fixed: after a reload or a loading screen in the middle of a boss fight or a PvP match, Whisper Messenger could hold your messages back without showing the "Messages are paused" notice, and could still hide whispers from the game's chat. The notice and the paused icon now show whenever your messages are held back, and whispers and channel messages stay in the game's chat until the fight or match is over.

## [2.1.7] - 2026-11-14

## [2.1.8] - 2026-11-16

- "Clear on logout" now also deletes the channel messages Whisper Messenger keeps to show above a new whisper. Before, they stayed saved until your next login.
- Smoother with a long Battle.net friend list: while the window is open, Whisper Messenger now does far less work each time a whisper arrives or a friend's status changes, and redraws the window far less often when the change is for a friend you have no chat with.

The notice and the paused icon now show whenever your messages are held back, and whispers and channel messages stay in the game's chat until the fight or match is over.

## [2.1.7] - 2026-11-14

- New option under Whispers: hide the player's last channel message that shows above a new whisper.
- Party, raid and instance chats now show the dungeon, raid or battleground they started in, e.g. "Party - Halls of Atonement - Current".
- New sound options under Notifications: pick a different sound for mentions, and turn on a sound for whispers you send (off by default).
- Community chats now show the community's name, and say that replies go through the game's Communities window instead of looking like you could type there.
- Reading a whisper in the game's own chat now clears it in Whisper Messenger too: click the game's whisper tab for that player, or start a whisper to them there.
- New option under Notifications: play a sound when a whisper lands in Requests, with its own sound so you can tell it apart from a friend's whisper. Off by default.
- New Behavior option "Esc closes the window". Turn it off to keep Whisper Messenger open when you press Esc; close it with its button or your Toggle Window key. Dying or opening a big game panel no longer closes it either while the option is off.
- Opening a chat by clicking a contact, the message preview (also one from another addon, like Craft Alert's new-lead preview), or the Whisper Messenger button or minimap icon, by pressing your Reply or Toggle Window key, starting a new whisper, clicking the chat header, or right-clicking a player and choosing Whisper now refreshes that player's zone and guild, and their level if "Show player levels" is on, when the info is more than 10 minutes old. This no longer needs "Show player levels" turned on. Before, a player was looked up only once. The game ignores lookups sent too close together; when that happens, your next click on the chat tries again instead of waiting 10 minutes.
- New option under General: "Look up players with /who". It's on by default; turn it off and Whisper Messenger stops these lookups, and the chat header no longer shows the zone or Online status they found. "Show player levels" now only shows or hides the level.
- That lookup now also fills in the player's class, race and faction in the chat header. A player the lookup finds now shows as Online, with the zone they're in, for 10 minutes, even when the game's own check said they were offline. After that, "Last seen" counts the lookup too.
- Contacts now show a small icon next to their name, in your contact list and at the top of the chat, when they are in your guild, on your Battle.net or friends list, or in one of your communities. Hover it to see all of them. You can turn it off with "Show relationship marks" in General settings.
- Fixed: typing a command like /use, /target, /focus or /cast in the message box no longer gets blocked by the game with an "AddOn tried to call a protected function" error. The game only allows these from its own chat box, so Whisper Messenger now shows the command ready to copy and paste into chat. Other commands like /roll and emotes still run right away.
- Fixed: "Guild invite" in a player's right-click menu no longer gets blocked by the game when you press Enter. It now shows the invite command ready to copy and paste into chat. On WoW: Forever the command now leaves out the realm, so the game finds the player.
- Fixed: players who are offline no longer show as online in your contact list and chat header, and cross-faction guild or community members who are online no longer show as offline.
- Fixed: letters the game's default font doesn't have, like the Hungarian ő and ű or the Polish ł, no longer show as squares. Messages, names, quotes, previews, notes, filter rules and quick replies switch to the game's chat font when the text needs one of them, and the message box, search box and other text boxes always use it, so the letters show while you type.
- Fixed: with the compact window open, Craft Alert no longer pops its own alert at the top of the screen for a new lead. The Craft Alert tab shows the new lead, and if you close the window soon after, the preview shows on the button.

## [2.1.6] - 2026-11-10

## [2.1.7] - 2026-11-14

- New option under Whispers: hide the player's last channel message that shows above a new whisper.
- Party, raid and instance chats now show the dungeon, raid or battleground they started in, e.g. "Party - Halls of Atonement - Current".
- New sound options under Notifications: pick a different sound for mentions, and turn on a sound for whispers you send (off by default).
- Community chats now show the community's name, and say that replies go through the game's Communities window instead of looking like you could type there.
- Reading a whisper in the game's own chat now clears it in Whisper Messenger too: click the game's whisper tab for that player, or start a whisper to them there.
- New option under Notifications: play a sound when a whisper lands in Requests, with its own sound so you can tell it apart from a friend's whisper. Off by default.
- New Behavior option "Esc closes the window". Turn it off to keep Whisper Messenger open when you press Esc; close it with its button or your Toggle Window key. Dying or opening a big game panel no longer closes it either while the option is off.
- Opening a chat by clicking a contact, the message preview (also one from another addon, like Craft Alert's new-lead preview), or the Whisper Messenger button or minimap icon, by pressing your Reply or Toggle Window key, starting a new whisper, clicking the chat header, or right-clicking a player and choosing Whisper now refreshes that player's zone and guild, and their level if "Show player levels" is on, when the info is more than 10 minutes old. This no longer needs "Show player levels" turned on. Before, a player was looked up only once. The game ignores lookups sent too close together; when that happens, your next click on the chat tries again instead of waiting 10 minutes.
- New option under General: "Look up players with /who". It's on by default; turn it off and Whisper Messenger stops these lookups, and the chat header no longer shows the zone or Online status they found. "Show player levels" now only shows or hides the level.
- That lookup now also fills in the player's class, race and faction in the chat header. A player the lookup finds now shows as Online, with the zone they're in, for 10 minutes, even when the game's own check said they were offline. After that, "Last seen" counts the lookup too.
- Contacts now show a small icon next to their name, in your contact list and at the top of the chat, when they are in your guild, on your Battle.net or friends list, or in one of your communities. Hover it to see all of them. You can turn it off with "Show relationship marks" in General settings.
- Fixed: typing a command like /use, /target, /focus or /cast in the message box no longer gets blocked by the game with an "AddOn tried to call a protected function" error. The game only allows these from its own chat box, so Whisper Messenger now shows the command ready to copy and paste into chat. Other commands like /roll and emotes still run right away.
- Fixed: "Guild invite" in a player's right-click menu no longer gets blocked by the game when you press Enter. It now shows the invite command ready to copy and paste into chat. On WoW: Forever the command now leaves out the realm, so the game finds the player.
- Fixed: players who are offline no longer show as online in your contact list and chat header, and cross-faction guild or community members who are online no longer show as offline.
- Fixed: letters the game's default font doesn't have, like the Hungarian ő and ű or the Polish ł, no longer show as squares. Messages, names, quotes, previews, notes, filter rules and quick replies switch to the game's chat font when the text needs one of them, and the message box, search box and other text boxes always use it, so the letters show while you type.
- Fixed: with the compact window open, Craft Alert no longer pops its own alert at the top of the screen for a new lead. The Craft Alert tab shows the new lead, and if you close the window soon after, the preview shows on the button.

## [2.1.6] - 2026-11-10

- The message preview can now be detached: pick "Detached" under Preview Position and drag the card anywhere on screen. It keeps its spot after a reload, and with both the widget and the minimap button on you get just one preview.
- Behavior settings now list every addon that uses Whisper Messenger under "Allow addon integration", each with its own checkbox. Untick one and it stops adding pages, previews and notes right away, with no reload. Addons that aren't loaded this session are greyed out and can be removed from the list with Forget.
- Fixed: after you had typed in Whisper Messenger once, linking an item in normal chat during a boss fight could make the game block your message and blame Whisper Messenger.
- Fixed: clicking an item link in the message preview or the Whisper Messenger window during combat no longer shows an "Interface action failed because of an AddOn" message. The item tooltip still opens.
- Fixed: shift-clicking a player's name in Whisper Messenger while you're typing a message now puts the name in your message without also running a /who.
- Fixed: the Link button at the top of the Professions window puts your profession link into the Whisper Messenger message box again.
- Fixed: right-clicking a player's name in chat while typing in Whisper Messenger no longer puts a broken link in your message that the game refuses to send.
- Fixed: the "Start a new conversation" box opened from an empty chat no longer sticks out past the edges of its window.
- Fixed: the Whisper Messenger button can no longer be dragged off the screen, and a button that was already off screen comes back to the edge.
- Fixed: opening Whisper Messenger with a key binding on a letter key (like Shift-G) no longer types that letter into the message box.
- Other addons can now drop their chat links straight into your Whisper Messenger message while you're typing it. Total RP 3 needs an update on its side before its links show up there.
- Fixed: a trade or general chat line from a different player with the same name on another realm no longer shows up inside your whisper with someone.
- "Same position on every character" (Icons settings) now also keeps the messenger window, its size and the minimap button in the same place on all your characters, not just the widget. A new character opens everything where you left it. If you already had it on, the first character you log in with after updating sets the shared window spot and minimap button angle.
- New option under Icons: Widget layer. Pick Low or Background to keep your bags and the character sheet on top of the widget; High (the default) keeps the widget above them.
- With the Native WoW look, the arrows at the ends of the chat tab row now light up when you point at them.

## [2.1.5] - 2026-11-08

- New compact window, off by default: turn it on with "Compact window" under Appearance settings. The messenger button grows into the window's top-left icon and opens a tall, narrow list of your chats. Click a chat to slide into it, and use the back arrow to slide back. The button keeps your unread count the whole time, and the window opens at the button, which flies onto it. New message pop-ups stay hidden while the window is open, so they never cover its title bar.
- Closing the compact window sends the icon back to where it came from. Settings open wider while they're showing, then the window returns to compact size.
- Addons that support it (Craft Alert) now open their page inside the compact window without widening it.
- The regular (non-compact) window now grows out of its icon when it opens and shrinks back into it when it closes.
- New option under Appearance: Window animation, to turn the opening and closing animation off. With it off, the compact window's pages also switch at once instead of sliding between the chat list and a chat.
- New option under Appearance: Dock button on the window. Turn it off and the floating button stays where it is while the window is open.
- New option under Appearance: Open at saved spot (on by default). Off, the window opens at the floating button, and the button follows when you move the window (while Dock button on the window is on). On, the window opens where you last moved it and the button stays where it is.
- The regular (non-compact) window now holds the floating button in its top-left corner while it is open, like the compact window does. A square button turns into the same round corner icon while it sits on the window; its border and background settings only change the floating button. You can still click the button to close the window or drag it to move the window. New message pop-ups stay hidden while the button sits on the open window.
- In the compact window, the tabs now stay below the window while a conversation is open; tap a tab to go back to its list.
- The Export conversation window now shows the whole saved conversation at once, with a taller text box; the Show more and Show all buttons are gone.
- Clicking the floating button while a message preview is showing now opens that conversation, in both the compact and the regular window. With no preview showing, the button works as before.
- Right-clicking a player in the contact list now offers "Guild invite" when you're allowed to invite: it types the invite command into your chat box, and you press Enter to send it. When the game wouldn't let that invite go through (often until you've used a chat command such as /say since logging in), it shows the command in a small box instead, ready to copy with Ctrl+C and paste into chat. Players on your own realm are named without the realm. It's hidden for your guildmates, and (with "Show player levels" on) for players the game has shown you in another guild this session.
- The square floating button now has slightly rounded corners, and its unread glow pulses along its edge like the round button's.
- When the tabs below the window don't all fit, arrows appear at the window's edges to scroll through the rest, and the tabs squeeze together slightly so more of them fit; the mouse wheel works too. With the Native WoW HUD style, tabs now show their full names instead of being cut short.
- With the Native WoW HUD on, the message box now uses the game's newer input box look on Retail and WoW: Forever, and the quick-reply box on the message preview matches it on every version.
- Fixed: In the compact window, the title no longer runs into the buttons next to it.
- Fixed: Turning off a tab such as Requests or Channels could leave it on screen on top of another tab until a reload.
- Fixed: Dragging the button while it sits on the open window no longer makes the window jump.
- Fixed: Messages from addon chat channels (like Forever Item Finder's) and other custom channels you haven't turned on as chats no longer show up inside your whisper chats. Channels you turned on as chats, and the game's own channels like Trade, still show their latest message there.
- Fixed: With "Auto-open on outgoing whisper" turned off, a greeting sent by clickin
